feature: DMG Synth paused physical-channel audition / Capture to Synth

scope.audition: Paused CH1/CH2 Pulse, CH3 Wave and CH4 Noise borrow the editor APU checkpoint; the reference APU and queued PCM stay untouched.
scope.capture: Keeps song Pause/frame, saves original and captured JSON presets atomically, switches to editable Synth; numbered CH restores the frozen view without losing edits.
scope.hardware: CH1-only Sweep; CH4 Noise ignores note pitch. Initial/configured registers are retriggered rather than elapsed Envelope/Sweep phases.
scope.ownership: Source/CH/view changes, Resume, Stop, Code and pagehide retire trials. Capture cancellation/rollback completes before a new owner starts; retry cannot replace that barrier.

actualWasm: Trials on all four physical channels leave the reference APU registers, generated frame count and author Wave RAM unchanged.
Resume after trials produces 12,000 stereo frames sample-exact to an untouched paused reference.
The restored author produces sample-exact next-note PCM compared with an unborrowed editor APU.
Noise MIDI 0/127 and Pitch do not retune Noise; only CH1 receives Sweep. Invalid low-key bend preserves the original held note.
transactions: Capacity/validation/stale precommit leave Files unchanged; postcommit cancellation/editor failures retain the committed captured sound.
Same physical CH selection after Capture repaints the song view; late key-up and delayed begin/configuration cannot affect a newer owner.

browser.regressionCandidateNote: Song, Code and baseline ran on the first candidate. The final candidate adds only a guard rejecting overlapping Capture retries; final Capture tests cover cancellation/rollback, Code ownership and successful retry on the final ZIP.

visualReview: Chromium captured Synth: original/new presets, Pause retained and editable 32-point Wave.
WebKit 390px: song selector, CH/Synth, Capture and keyboard stay within viewport.
limits: The captured preset contains configured settings, not game note history, hardware length counters or elapsed Envelope/Sweep phase.
Reference VGM playback remains a single pass; seek and loop repetition are outside this change.
Existing normal-clock single-DMG/direct-write VGM coverage and the shared 16 MiB project limit remain.
